reason: This changes behavior for localized content items with AutoroutePart by clearing the cloned path so a new permalink is auto-generated, which is a targeted, feature-gated (ContentLocalization) change but could surprise sites that relied on the previous behavior of duplicating the exact path/pattern when localizing content.
